newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota 96/97 profit seen rising 82 pct - Nikkei.
newsitem.headline: Toyota 96/97 profit seen rising 82 pct - Nikkei.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp is expected to post a parent current profit of 620 billion yen for the year to March 1997, helped by the weak yen against the U.S. dollar, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun (Nikkei) reported on Sunday.
This would constitute an 82 percent jump from a profit of 340.73 billion yen the previous year, Nikkei said.
Nikkei said the weak yen against the dollar would help Toyota increase profits from its exports.
In November, Toyota forecast a parent current profit of 550 billion yen for the year to March.
